whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dance & Zumba Centre,

I noticed your dance and fitness center has a perfect 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online trial bookings.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp batch booking, zumba/dance class schedules, aur location integration hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dancezumba

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Dance & Zumba Centre, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness studio ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp batch booking and your 5.0-star rating highlights in Kankarbagh, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact class timings aur actual studio photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
